_readme: Theme config — edit and refresh. Set 'active' to a preset name, or edit the preset's hex values. The loader (index.html) applies every key below as a CSS variable, so all colors follow from these tokens. Requires serving over http (localhost server or GitHub Pages). If opened via file:// the site falls back to the defaults baked into styles.css.
